mandate: C427 — test the price-only LOCTIME: price-path local time and excursion heights (Shannon entropy of the local-time distribution lt_entropy, normalized peak local time lt_max_height, mean/max excursion height exc_mean/exc_max) stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (2592 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|. Over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t] (W+1 bars): discretize C into B=32 equal-width bins between min(C) and max(C); local time L_b=count of visits to bin b (sum L_b = W+1); lt_entropy=-sum_b p_b log p_b (Shannon entropy of the local-time distribution); lt_max_height=max_b L_b/((W+1)/B) (normalized peak local time); excursion heights from local extrema (drawdown/drawup before the next extremum); exc_mean=mean excursion height; exc_max=max excursion height. NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in C[t-W..t], degenerate window (min==max), or not finite. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 8 real+placebo (lt_entropy_dev, lt_max_height_dev, exc_mean_dev, exc_max_dev) + 4 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W+1-bar close window).

methodology.raw_features: perp_close real 5m kline close from C312 (strictly positive, gap-free); log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing closes C=c_i[t-W..t] (W+1 bars); discretize C into B=32 equal-width bins between min(C) and max(C); local time L_b=count of visits to bin b (sum L_b = W+1); lt_entropy=-sum_b p_b log p_b (Shannon entropy of the local-time distribution); lt_max_height=max_b L_b/((W+1)/B) (normalized peak local time); excursion heights from local extrema (drawdown/drawup before the next extremum); exc_mean=mean excursion height; exc_max=max excursion height.
methodology.signals: lt_entropy_dev/lt_max_height_dev/exc_mean_dev/exc_max_dev plus phase-randomized-surrogate placebos over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 2592 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 8 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.loctime_vectorization_note: close matrix C=(T,10) built once; per asset, close series c[j]; per window ending at t, trailing W+1=257 closes c[t-W..t]; discretize into B=32 equal-width bins; local time L_b=count of visits to bin b; lt_entropy=Shannon entropy; lt_max_height=normalized peak; excursion heights from local extrema; exc_mean/exc_max per window; validated against brute-force per-window loop with explicit local-time binning + excursion extraction, maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
